summary: Recent updates in the Media IPC (Inter-Process Communication) area of Firefox enhance the browser's ability to support **protected playback**, crucial for playing back content secured by Digital Rights Management (DRM). Improvements include better hardware support for decoding protected video streams using Microsoft's Media Foundation Content Decryption Module (MFCDM), which ensures that content is securely rendered. This update also incorporates readiness checks and logging to ensure that the media's protected playback capabilities are functioning optimally, thereby improving user experience when accessing streaming services. After these changes, Firefox is now more robust in handling protected content, which is increasingly important as more streaming platforms implement DRM to safeguard their media.
